titulo: Props: pilares, pedras e árvores mortas
prompt: Create a game-ready 2D SPRITE SHEET for the top-down action-RPG "Echoes of the Shatter" (Godot, camera looking down from above like Tibia / Diablo 1: high top-down 3/4 view, about 55 degrees pitch). Style: hand-painted stylized 2D, chunky shapes, dark outline 2-3 px, warm gold + cold purple/teal neon accents, grey cracked stone crypt palette, exactly matching the attached official reference sheet (same painting style, line weight and colors). Flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, NO ground shadow, NO scenery, NO text, NO labels, no glow bleeding outside its cell. STRICT GRID: perfect grid of 6 columns x 4 rows, every cell identical (256x256 px at 1536x1024), one prop per cell, centered, base of the prop at the same height in every cell (85% down the cell), nothing crossing cell borders, each prop fully inside its cell. Props seen from above-front, lit from top-left. Row 1: 6 stone pillars (intact carved pillar with gold runes, tall slender pillar, short thick pillar, cracked pillar, half-broken pillar with rubble, fallen pillar lying on its side). Row 2: 6 rocks and boulders (large grey boulder, small rock cluster, mossy boulder, jagged rock with purple crystal veins, flat slab stones, pile of rubble). Rows 3-4: 12 dead trees and dead plants (twisted bare dead tree large, dead tree medium, dead tree with hanging cobwebs, leaning dead tree, tree stump with roots, hollow dead trunk, thorny dead bush, bare roots clump, withered shrub, dead tree with a few glowing teal leaves, gnarled tree with a skull in the trunk, small dead sapling).
